missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Тоска' is a feminine noun in the nominative case, acting as the subject of 'проходит'. 'По дому' specifies what the longing is for.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Тоску' is the direct object of 'чувствую'. The feminine ending -а shifts to -у in the accusative singular, and 'глубокую' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Тоски' is the genitive form after 'от', expressing the cause of the crying. The feminine genitive singular ends in -и after к.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantifier. 'Тоски' is genitive because 'много' governs the genitive case. 'Осенью' sets the time when the feeling arises.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Тоске' is the dative form required by the verb 'предаться'. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine dative singular.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Тоской' is the instrumental form after 'с', describing how she sang. The feminine instrumental singular ends in -ой.

missions.phrase: В её тоске была настоящая боль.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Тоске' is the prepositional form after 'в', naming the location of the feeling. The feminine prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative with adjective. 'Тоска' is nominative as the subject of the clause. 'Зимняя' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'каждому' takes the dative.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Тоски' is the plural accusative direct object of 'описывают'. For inanimate feminine nouns the plural accusative equals the nominative plural in -и.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Тоска' is nominative as the subject of 'охватила'. 'Сильная' agrees in feminine, and the verb stands in the feminine past tense.
